verdict.rationale: The vendor states plainly that nothing is uploaded and that Filee works offline, so files never leave the computer. Conversion engines are bundled or installed locally (the 7-Zip engine, plus optional FFmpeg/LibreOffice/Calibre/Ghostscript/Pandoc), which supports fully on-machine conversion. missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification (e.g. a network audit) that conversions make no network calls.

support.subject: As a power user, conversion runs entirely on my machine, and the vendor states that files are never uploaded

citations.quote: Nothing is uploaded. Filee works offline, so private documents, photos and recordings never leave your computer.
Large engines are optional. Tick them in the installer or download them in the app later: FFmpeg, LibreOffice, Calibre, Ghostscript and Pandoc.
